heard: From the sons of Joseph came a line. Ephraim stood with heart and mind. Ammihud named his father was. Elishama led the chosen class. Meleshama, son of Amiud, leader of the tribe that stood On the west side under flag, guiding Israel through the track When the camp was set in order, standard raised to find the border Billy Sharma led the people through With the census count to view Billy Sharma, son of Amiibu Leader of the tribe that stood
